subject: Re: BrightWave renewal — increase hosted commit + rate band adjustment
messages:
From: Elena Moreno <elena@brightwave.com>
To: diego_fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
Cc: BrightWave Procurement <procurement@brightwave.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal discussion + suggested commit increase

Hi Diego,

We're starting our renewal planning for November and wanted to discuss a possible commit increase for our hosted API plan. Over the last 10 months BrightWave has grown prompt volume ~2.4x and our token consumption is trending above the current 1M monthly commit.

Quick asks:
- Can Redwood provide pricing for a 2.5M token/month committed band (12-month term)?
- What changes to rate-limits and burst windows would you recommend to preserve latency for our customer-facing flows?
- Any option for a modest onboarding credit or pro-rate in the first month?

We can loop in procurement once we have ballpark numbers. Happy to run a short call this week.

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Moreno
Head of Engineering, BrightWave
elena@brightwave.com
+1 415-555-0199
From: diego_fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
To: Elena Moreno <elena@brightwave.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion + suggested commit increase

Elena —

Thanks for the heads up. We'd love to support the increase. High-level response to your asks:

- Pricing: For a 12-month committed band at 2.5M tokens/month we propose the attached tier sheet. Net effective per-token drops ~18% vs your current band, and we can include a one-time onboarding credit equal to 10% of the first month of overage to offset migration spikes.
- Rate limits: We recommend raising the default token-rate per second for your primary production route to 900 TPS (from 600 TPS) and expand the burst window to 90 seconds for short peak spikes. That preserves tail latency for short lived surges.
- Contract mechanics: We can mirror your current renewal date; SOW will add the higher commit and an automatic quarterly telemetry review to tune batching and cache settings.

Next steps: I’ll work with Rishi and Laura on a formal SOW and a pricing addendum. Can you put procurement on copy if there are PO or billing contact constraints?

Proposed quick call slots: Wed 7/15 10:00-11:00 or Thu 7/16 14:00-15:00 PT.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
diego@redwood.com

Attachment: redwood-hosted-pricing-2026.xlsx
From: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: diego_fernandez <diego@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 08:19:00 -0700
Subject: FW: BrightWave renewal — technical + pricing notes

Diego / Laura —

Notes from product side for the SOW:

- Capacity: We should propose a baseline reserved pool with headroom for 30% burst. For their traffic profile, a 2.5M commit with a 30% burst pool buys them predictable tail latency during marketing-driven spikes.
- Quantization/Model choice: Suggest continuing on the current v2-optim model; schedule a quantization pass only if token/unit costs exceed forecast by >12% in first 2 quarters.
- Observability: Add a monthly telemetry digest (token distribution by route, tail P99 latency, cache hit rates). This will be part of the operational review.
- Legal/term: 12-month term seems fine; include a 60-day termination notice for exceptional compliance events (standard for Private).

I'll draft the technical appendix for the SOW and send to Diego by EOD.

-rishi
Senior Product Manager — Redwood Inference
From: diego_fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
To: Elena Moreno <elena@brightwave.com>, BrightWave Procurement <procurement@brightwave.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed amendment: 2.5M monthly commit (12mo) + rate-band changes

Elena / procurement team —

Appended is the proposed commercial amendment and a short SOW excerpt (attached as BrightWave_SOW_v2.pdf). Highlights:

- Commit: 2,500,000 tokens/month (12-month committed term starting 2026-11-01)
- Pricing: $0.00095 per token on committed volume; overage priced at $0.00110 per token with a 30% escalator if usage >200% of committed for two consecutive months
- Rate limits: production route rate increased to 900 TPS; burst window 90s; per-route fallback to a configured canary model if primary capacity reached
- Onboarding credit: one-time credit applied to first invoice equal to 10% of billed committed volume for month 1 to cover migration surges
- Observability: monthly telemetry digest and quarterly review with product ops (no extra fee)

Requested next steps from you:
1) Confirm commercial terms and provide PO contact and billing address
2) If terms OK, sign amendment (DocuSign link below) and we will finalize SOW and schedule a kickoff for configuration and traffic shaping

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/ABCDEF123456

If procurement prefers a call, I can join Thu 7/22 11:00 PT.

Regards,
Diego
Attachment: BrightWave_SOW_v2.pdf; redwood-hosted-pricing-2026.xlsx

Diego —

Thanks for the clear summary. Procurement is comfortable with the commercial outline. A couple of items before we can issue a PO:

- Please confirm the invoice cadence (monthly) and the exact billing contact and remittance address (BrightWave prefers ACH).
- We need the finalized SOW and the signed amendment before issuing PO. Can you confirm how long after DocuSign execution we will receive the countersigned document?
- Please also confirm any SLA credits or penalties tied to availability thresholds for the Dedicated features mentioned in the SOW (we expect an SLA appendix).

If you can provide that by EOD Thu 7/22 we can push the PO through next week.

Thanks,
Marty Cleary
